mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% month-over-month signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator for overall economic demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals labor market weakness, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side activity, which is a positive indicator for economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening consumer demand, which is a positive indicator for economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the time periods analyzed.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals labor market weakness, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it signals inflationary pressure under a tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: inflationary pressure under tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative for two consecutive quarters and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 6%, it signals a recessionary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 negative for 2 consecutive quarters and UNRATE > 6%
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.
